trials.role: Intravenous SKI 2053R monotherapy in advanced malignancies
trials.outcome: Clinical MTD 480 mg/m² on the 1-hour intravenous infusion schedule every four weeks. Hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity and myelosuppression were dose limiting. The recommended Phase II starting dose was 360 mg/m² every four weeks.

toxicity.Notes: Preclinical study, pp. 83–84, acute toxicity. Single intraperitoneal dose. Gross and histopathological changes in kidney and liver were reported in animals that died.

pk.Notes: Table 1 (3 beagle dogs, randomized crossover, equitoxic doses): ultrafiltrable Pt: t1/2 alpha 0.37 h, t1/2 beta 2.19 h, CL 16.83 mL/min/kg, AUC0-inf 7.72 ug h/mL; total Pt: t1/2 alpha 0.53 h, AUC0-24 21.91 ug h/mL; protein binding 35% in the first hour, 97% by 24 h; cisplatin 2.5 mg/kg and carboplatin 15 mg/kg studied in parallel; antitumour activity only ex vivo (inhibition of cell lines by plasma ultrafiltrate)
